Domain: Mental — Resource: Focus — Specialty: Strain — Specialty Condition: Strain

Supernatural force produced directly through the mind — telepathy, telekinesis, altered perception, prediction, and manipulation of bodily or cognitive processes.

Strain

Whenever you use a Psionics Action or Reaction, you may gain 1 Strain to gain 1 additional Surge for it. Strain is cumulative and remains until removed. At 1-2 Strain, no penalty. At 3-4, each Psionics Action/Reaction burns 1 additional die. At 5+, suffer 1 Psychic damage after resolving a Psionics Action/Reaction. Strain is removed only by effects that specifically remove it, or by Recovery.

Expertises

  • Telepathy
  • Telekinesis
  • Precognition
  • Clairvoyance
  • Imprint
  • Biokinesis
  • Mesmerism

Subtypes

  • Assault
  • Barrier
  • Projection
  • Fracture
  • Trance
